propositions: adf.py's text_to_adf encodes Markdown literally (headings/lists/bold as raw characters), not as ADF block nodes, causing Cloud to render source syntax
A pure Markdown-aware encode function markdown_to_adf must complement the existing plain-text adf_to_text decode, added to adf.py without changing AdfCodec ops or live send paths
Combined strong+strikethrough marks oscillate in a 2-cycle under repeated round-trip unless a mark-order canonicalizer sorts marks deterministically
marklas (mistune-based) drops HTML comments during encode, risking loss of rebar's own <!-- rebar:reconciler-echo --> marker, requiring self-verification in markdown_to_adf

The stdlib-only engine contract and subprocess import path forbid vendoring marklas+mistune; lazy-import with ImportError fallback to plain adf.py must degrade gracefully when the optional extra is absent
Over 360 committed corpus bodies, the round-trip must reach 99.6% fixed-point idempotence, preserve 15% structural richness (block nodes), and scrub all unscrubbed secrets
